item.title: Noah Westbrook breaks King's 1 meter diving record set in 1974, meets record holder Mark Brown
item.description: Mark Brown returned to Corpus Christi after many years to meet the King diver that broke his 52-year-old record, Noah Westbrook. Both divers learned from the same coach, Trey Collins. #RecruitTheCoast

item.title: King's Westbrook and Perez, Flour Bluff's Hobbs advance to UIL 5A State
item.description: King's Noah Westbrook placed second and Anthony Perez finished third at the UIL 5A Region VIII Diving meet. Jessica Hobbs secured the Region Championship for Flour Bluff. All three advance to State.

item.title: Sinton wins district championship over Beeville 47-34, McHugh's 50th win in 2 years
item.description: The Sinton Lady Pirates won their first UIL District Championship in girls basketball since 1995, according to the trophy case. Head coach Ashley McHugh has guided this squad since seventh grade.
